title: jmap_post opens new TCP+TLS connection per call in watch.rs
description: watch.rs jmap_post opens a fresh TCP connection and performs a full TLS handshake on every call (lines 491-497). In fetch_and_notify this means two TLS handshakes per SSE state event (one for Message/changes, one for Message/get). Over a long-running watch session with frequent messages this is noticeable overhead. By contrast client.rs in kith-tui uses a persistent reqwest::Client with connection pooling. The watch module could use reqwest instead of hand-rolled HTTP over tokio-rustls to get connection reuse.
